title: Data Principles Catalogue
description: Catalogue of architecture principles for the Data architecture domain — vendor-neutral guidelines that shape design decisions. Aligned to TOGAF Architecture Principles (Name, Statement, Rationale, Implications).

meta.description: The guiding principles that shape how Data architecture decisions are made.
purpose: Ensures data decisions align with data strategy and wider business direction
Provides consistent guidance on data quality, ownership, and access patterns
Reduces technical debt caused by inconsistent data design choices
Enables automated analysis of data decisions against established principles
Creates a shared contract between data, application, and integration teams

statement.description: The principle, stated as a directive

rationale.description: Why this principle exists — the underlying motivation

implications.description: Consequences for design and decision-making if this principle is adopted
